# E0 Q3 eligible-expansion predictions

Registered before any of the four expansion cells is launched.

## Fixed cohort

The original fresh-corpus CPU gate marked 10/18 motions `worth_a_rollout`. E0-Q3 V8 measured a
stratified six-motion subset. This expansion is the complete remainder: indices 002, 003, 015,
and 017. Selection therefore does not depend on any new physics outcome.

## Predictions

1. All four cells will complete as gradeable 50 Hz trajectories with zero external collision
   force in the `screen_empty` obstacle-absent proxy.
2. At least three of four will satisfy the frozen reference-trackability policy. This is an
   aggregate prediction; no cell-level acceptance prediction is registered.
3. The straight duck carrier (003) will retain a lower reference torso/root posture than the
   straight walk carrier (000), but Q3 acceptance remains a measurement rather than a prediction.
4. Every scientific rejection is retained. There are no per-cell retries, and no result is
   promoted beyond Q3 single-seed evidence.

## Resource prediction

Trajectory-only cells should remain within the measured 4.9 GiB process-memory envelope and
finish well below 375 seconds each. The batch retains the measured 6,000 MiB launch threshold and
strict serial execution; 9,000 MiB free VRAM is not required when camera rendering is disabled.
